decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core range costs little to keep on existing bakery lines, and there is no sign of failure, so the option stays worth holding.
A sweet pastry made with existing skills and ingredients has a low carrying cost and still uncertain but plausible demand, so keeping it beats dropping it.
The farmhouse bread is a recent, cheap-to-produce addition to the core assortment whose value has not resolved negatively, so management keeps the option open.
The poppy seed stollen won a gold award and has its own web page, so its value is being realized as a seasonal specialty with low ongoing cost.
The premium stollen's gold award shows strong quality recognition supporting seasonal and gift sales, so the firm keeps investing in it.
